visible.message:
A text_input gets its default from Session State via setdefault, but when it is rendered only under a condition, switching the selectbox makes it lose the value, and the key disappears from Session State. Code:

st.session_state.setdefault('input2', 'input 2')
st.session_state.setdefault('input3', 'input 3')
select = st.selectbox('select', ['A', 'B'])
if select == 'A':
    st.text_input('input 2', key='input2')
else:
    st.text_input('input 3', key='input3')

Streamlit 1.34.0, Python 3.8, Windows, Edge.

agent_script.user_draft: Streamlit deletes the Session State entry of any widget that was not rendered at the end of a run, and even temporarily hiding a widget resets it. When you switch to B, input2's key is removed. To keep values while a widget is hidden, store them in a separate placeholder key and copy them back when the widget is shown.
agent_script.maintainer_summary: Documented widget clean-up deletes keys of unrendered widgets.

evidence_links.claim: Streamlit deletes Session State pairs of widgets not rendered at the end of a run.
Temporarily hiding a widget resets it; save the value to a separate key.

When the passages were supplied and cover the case, escalation is unnecessary abstention.
